verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents its own call-analytics feature: 'advanced call activity with history and trends' viewable in its app and online dashboard. That roughly covers call volume, but the evidence appears to come from the home-plan feature list, and the business pages offer only missed-call alerts and multi-user number management. Missing for 10: per-number breakdowns, per-teammate breakdowns, answer-rate metrics, missed-call reporting (as opposed to alerts), business-plan analytics documentation, independent corroboration.
